cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 88 (Autauga and Elmore counties) since November 2022. Army National Guard lieutenant colonel. Career in corrections and probation and parole, including district manager with the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles. Served three terms on the Prattville city council.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Jerry Starnes was born, where he grew up, or when he came to Alabama. We found no list of the bills he sponsored. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by outside buyers, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and his only survey answers are from 2022. Those answers mention education as a passion but give no specific position. We found no controversies and no endorsements for him.

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2022 and three-term Prattville city councilman. His career includes correctional officer, executive security officer at the Governor's Mansion, and Autauga County probation and parole district manager. He also reached lieutenant colonel in the Army National Guard.
qual.why: Prior legislative service at the state level and in city government, plus a long state-agency management career in criminal justice. His work is public safety rather than law or budget, so the score is below the top of the range.
